text: For D332509 at revision bf9bb06ea004bd392f67d079c3145ab2978cafb2, the AI review suggests separate helpers for option creation and comparison, while keeping control replacement and focus restoration together. The stated reason is that the method combines control lifetime, an operation-bound listener, option updates, selection, color, and focus. This is an unaccepted, nonblocking maintenance suggestion; the review explicitly says the current comparison is correct and establishes no functional failure. If this refactor is pursued, preserve operation-replacement focus tests, loading-focus tests, stale-selection tests, and the unit selector-identity check. This does not establish a general component convention or independently verify the stale-selection contract.
title: Calendar selector refactor must preserve control and focus behavior
